description:
Create, list, show and delete person files. People are link targets for note attendees and task assignees; they are not threads.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list people, open ones only by default
  show PERSON [--json] — show one person file
  new --name NAME --category CATEGORY — create a person file
  delete PERSON -y — permanently delete a person file

Args:
  QUERY   optional fuzzy search; results are ranked by similarity
  PERSON  full name, matching the filename without .md

Flags:
  list:
    --all            include closed people
    --json           JSON output
  show:
    --json           JSON output
  new:
    --name NAME      required. Full name; becomes the filename. Must not contain '/' or start with '.'.
    --category CAT   required. One of: professional, personal, voluntary
  delete:
    -y, --yes        required to confirm

Examples:
  ["list", "riaz"]
  ["show", "Riaz Arbi", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Riaz Arbi", "--category", "professional"]

Notes:
  Nothing prompts. delete is destructive and refuses to run without -y.
  Create the person before naming them as a task assignee (`tasks set-assignee`, '(Name) ...' in `tasks add`).
  Exit 1: empty name, a name containing '/' or starting with '.', person already exists, person not found, or delete without -y.

BLOCKED: delete. These subcommands are refused and calling one returns an error. Do not attempt them.
